description: Extend fused structural compaction and programmatic dependent launch to heterogeneous n=1024. Classify matrices into k384/k608/k768 low-rank, two-level/banded, and full-rank remainder groups, stage each solver once, overlap custom tensor-core reduced solves with the low-occupancy cuSOLVER remainder, and join through one fused scatter/residual gate. Reuse the validated n512 scheduling architecture while independently tuning n1024 cluster counts, dependency triggers, and precision cleanup.

Implemented one-pass six-way n1024 compaction into k384/k608/k768 low-rank, exact two-level, narrow-band and remainder routes; staged all low-rank Rayleigh blocks and fused their outer gate, grouped two-level/band, and scattered three outputs once. Build and 39/39 validation passed, but production mixed1024 failed its harness eigen residual on matrix 12 (scaled 2.59e4), so no metric was emitted.

Fixed the cuSOLVER remainder eigenvector layout before fused scatter. One-pass 7/31/3 k384/k608/k768 + 5 two-level + 1 narrow-band + 13 remainder route passes 39/39 and benchmark correctness, but mixed1024 regresses from the parent floor to 339879.669 us and aggregate 27530.555 us. Fused low-rank gate sees 11 bad and rescues 3, leaving 8 full-n fallbacks.

Tightened heterogeneous-only bands after per-bucket gates: k384 PR<65, k608 PR100-120, k768 PR280-400; exact-rank PR80 and failing PR223 rows stay in the remainder. Valid 39/39. Mixed1024 improves 339879.669->211154.379 us and aggregate 27530.555->26524.404 us, but remains above the parent cuSOLVER floor.

Added cluster-secondary PDL launch support and a heterogeneous med/cluster chain. The 25 non-projector remainder rows run in one full-n C=5 cluster primary; k608 then k384 reduced grids launch as dependents; five two-level rows use one projector solve; one final scatter. Valid 39/39. Mixed1024 improves 211154.379->105322.177 us and aggregate 26524.404->25161.131 us, within 0.04% of parent.

Split the 25-row full-n C=5 remainder primary into 13/12-row dependent grids before k608/k384, aiming to release PDL earlier. Valid 39/39, but duplicate backtransform/NS/gate pipelines and contention regress mixed1024 105322.177->224527.191 us and aggregate 25161.131->26656.467 us.

Graceful operator-requested stop. Best candidate is 3c275b0b3: real heterogeneous n1024 six-way compaction with conservative k384/k608/k768 bands, exact two-level and narrow-band classification; one fused low-rank gate; full-n C=5 remainder primary plus cluster-secondary PDL support; one final scatter. It passes 39/39, mixed1024=105322.177 us, aggregate=25161.131 us versus parent 25150.416. Profile shows the unsplit C=5 remainder 49.276 ms, then k608/k384 both 18.76 ms (trigger released only at primary tail). Tried broad bands (339879.669 us with 8 fallbacks), tightened serial bands (211154.379 us), unsplit PDL (105322.177 us), and split PDL (224527.191 us; duplicate cleanup dominates). Further openings: split the primary launches while sharing one combined backtransform/NS/gate, reduce C=5 launch-completion latency without duplicating cleanup, or remove the two-row k384 fixed floor. Final profiled trial is 3d1adfe19; manager should select 3c275b0b3.
